svg.title: Remission or mild sleep apnea without daytime sleepiness
svg.desc: Remission or mild sleep apnea without daytime sleepiness. SURMOUNT-OSA trial 1: placebo 15.9%, drug 42.2%. SURMOUNT-OSA trial 2: placebo 14.3%, drug 50.2%. TRIUMPH-1-OSA, 9 mg: placebo 12.5%, drug 51.6%. TRIUMPH-1-OSA, 12 mg: placebo 12.5%, drug 42.3%. TRIUMPH-2-OSA, 9 mg: placebo 12.6%, drug 39.5%. TRIUMPH-2-OSA, 12 mg: placebo 12.6%, drug 38.9%.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Share with AHI under 5, or 5 to 14 with an Epworth sleepiness score of 10 or less, at trial end.
